historical_record.description: The Recreation and Park Commission approved Jens Hansen's revised plan, already passed by the Art Commission, for the restaurant to be built at the Marina Small Craft Harbor by Charley Brown Restaurants, Inc.
The Lita Vietor Memorial at the Marina Yacht Harbor, honoring Lita Di Grazia Vietor at her favorite view, was dedicated on October 18, 1985.
The Recreation and Park Commission ratified a $266,200 contract with Interlane General Engineering and Watkin and Bortolussi, Inc. for irrigating the Marina Green, within a $443,795 budget.

The Recreation and Park Commission gave conceptual approval to a preferred plan for the Marina, dropping a proposed restaurant and asking that the new outer West Marina breakwater be placed to accommodate the Wave Organ; in April it approved a state loan application for the breakwaters, dock replacement, dredging and a new pier.

The Recreation and Park Commission approved a plan to restore the Marina's west inner harbor seawall and steps, damaged in the Loma Prieta earthquake, with a wider walkway around the concession kiosk and disabled access.
The Recreation and Park Commission awarded Pan-Marine Constructors and A.R. Construction a $117,861 contract to rehabilitate the west end restrooms at the Marina Yacht Harbor.
The Recreation and Park Commission ratified a $207,100 contract with Dutra Construction for dredging at the Marina Yacht Harbor.
